title: LiteLLM v1.111.0 adds Customer Management and performance alerts
points: Customer Management adds customer organizations, teams and members, each with its own budgets, rate limits and daily usage in the dashboard.
Performance alerts flag spend and traffic spikes, slower responses and higher error rates against the previous seven days, and are on by default.
Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, Gemini 4 Carbon and Hydrogen, and 1,020 new fal.ai and Replicate models join the model catalog.
The Docker image now runs as non-root, `helm/litellm` is the only chart, and `LITELLM_EMAIL_FALLBACK_LINKS_ANY_USER=true` restores the old SSO email matching.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.17 (LTS) fixes streamed OpenAI tool calls and adds MiniMax-H3-Image
points: Streamed OpenAI tool calls keep their arguments when OpenAI sends them only at the end, and `chat-latest` models on OpenAI, Azure and Azure AI stop failing with 400.
MiniMax-H3-Image is new on `/v1/images/generations` and `/v1/images/edits`, and Gemini file inputs on chat completions take page and sheet ranges.
OpenAI Agents API sessions through `/openai` now count toward key and team budgets, and a Bedrock Claude tool with shared `$defs` no longer stalls a worker.

title: LiteLLM v1.110.4 and v1.109.5 speed up restricted end-user refreshes
points: Restricted end-user refreshes read a small partial index instead of scanning the whole end-user table every minute on each worker.
The standalone UI image moves to nginx 1.31.10 and zlib 1.4.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.16 (LTS) adds Perplexity Orchestrator and fixes Codex on Bedrock
points: Perplexity Orchestrator, Gradium text-to-speech, Gnani transcription and `gemini-decision-1` are new on the LTS line.
Codex over `ws /v1/responses` keeps working after its first tool call on Bedrock, Azure AI and OpenRouter, and Anthropic SDK 2.x calls stop failing under `anthropic-version: 2026-10-21`.

Set `LITELLM_MCP_DCR_GATEWAY_CLIENT=true` to keep automatic gateway-owned MCP DCR registration, and set `api_key` or `AZURE_API_KEY` on `azure` `/openai/v1` deployments that relied on `OPENAI_API_KEY`.

title: LiteLLM v1.110.3 and v1.109.4 make gateway MCP DCR registration opt-in
points: New clientless MCP DCR bridges relay the client's own registration again, which fixes `403 oauth_principal_mismatch` for shared service keys.
Set `LITELLM_MCP_DCR_GATEWAY_CLIENT=true` before you upgrade if you rely on automatic gateway-owned registration.
v1.110.3 also fixes `GET /audit` returning 500 after a key or team update and checks file ownership on `/gemini` pass-through files.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.15 (LTS) adds ResetData and fixes Cohere v2 chat params
points: ResetData is a new provider, and Groq and Meta transcription now record spend at listed prices instead of $0.
Cohere v2 chat sends `tool_choice`, `reasoning_effort` and `json_schema` `response_format` to Cohere, and streamed tool calls arrive whole.
A JSON-configured deployment without an `api_key` now gets a 401, so set the provider's key env var or an `api_key` before you upgrade.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.14 (LTS) fixes Claude tool search on Responses follow-ups
points: Claude's tool search stays on `/v1/responses` follow-up turns, also with `store: false`, so Anthropic no longer answers 400.
`/v1/decisions` accepts OpenAI `input_json` content parts, so a body that OpenAI accepts directly also works through the proxy.

title: LiteLLM v1.110.2 and v1.111.0rc3 fix Responses stream restarts
points: Responses streams stop retrying once output reached the client and stop restarting on a fallback after reasoning output.
GPT-6.2 caches system prompts on stored requests, and `temperature=1` works again on Claude models that removed sampling params.
On v1.111.0rc3, failed calls free large request bodies without waiting for a full GC, and SSO login works behind TLS termination.

title: LiteLLM v1.109.3 and v1.106.12 fix GPT-6.2 caching on stored requests
points: GPT-6.2 caches system prompts on `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/messages` when `store` is on or unset, not only with `store: false`.
`/key/info` stops a key with no user from reading other userless keys, and both lines move to a newer Wolfi base image.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.13 (LTS) fixes Unix-socket Postgres boot and GPT-6.2 caching
points: Proxies on a Unix-socket Postgres such as Cloud SQL boot again, since the migration lock keeps the socket path from `?host=`.
GPT-6.2 caches system prompts on stored requests, and Claude Code's rotating billing header no longer breaks prompt caching on non-Anthropic models.
`/key/info` stops a key with no user from reading other userless keys, and JWT key mappings without `jwt_issuer` apply right away.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.12 (LTS) fixes GPT-6.2 caching and Foundry model routers
points: GPT-6.2 caches system prompts on `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/messages` requests that set `store: false`, so repeated prompts cost less.
`azure_ai/model_router` entries on a Foundry `/openai/v1` base work on `/v1/responses` and `/v1/responses/compact` and record the routed model's cost.
The `tool_policy` guardrail applies to tool names longer than 64 characters on `/v1/messages`, and Vertex batch files with one `json_schema` row answer every row.

title: LiteLLM v1.110.1, v1.111.0rc2 and v1.106.11 fix GPT-6.2 prompt caching
points: GPT-6.2 caches system prompts on `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/messages` requests that set `store: false`, so repeated prompts cost less.
Stored requests and `previous_response_id` follow-ups keep the system prompt in `instructions`, so follow-up turns do not send the prompt twice.
On v1.110.1 the UI image runs on slim nginx without `curl`, so change exec probes on that image to `wget`.

title: LiteLLM v1.109.2 adds Gemini batches and fixes OOM on 429 retries
points: Gemini batches run on `/v1/batches`, with output download through `/v1/files` and spend tracking.
The proxy refuses blocked and over-limit keys before it reads the request body, and SSO login works again behind TLS termination.
The UI image runs on slim nginx without `curl`, so change exec probes on that image to `wget`.

title: LiteLLM v1.110.0 adds the Agent Skills Hub and a Rust-only router
points: The router always runs on the Rust core, and a router config that the Rust core declines now stops the proxy at startup.
Spend goes through the `LiteLLM_SpendLogDelivery` ledger by default, and `general_settings.use_spend_logs_ledger: false` restores the previous spend queues.
The Agent Skills Hub adds skill upload and import, version history and an admin review queue for member submissions.
Model and pass-through routes refuse Azure login fields such as `client_id` and `tenant_id` in the request body, so move them into `metadata`.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.11 (LTS) fixes OOM on 429 retries and SSO behind TLS
points: The proxy refuses blocked and over-limit keys before it reads the request body, so clients that retry 429s with large bodies no longer exhaust memory.
SSO login no longer goes through `/sso/key/generate/` or redirects to `http://` behind TLS termination.
Team admins get a 403 when they set `os.environ/` values on team models, so a proxy admin sets those values.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.10 (LTS) fixes Vertex Claude 4096-token cap and EU o3 spend
points: Versioned Claude models on Vertex AI, such as `claude-*@<version>`, no longer stop at 4096 tokens when the request has no `max_tokens`.
Deployments with `base_model` set to `azure/eu/o3`, `o4-mini`, `o1` or `o3-mini` record real spend instead of $0.
Async Codestral chat with a `file` part no longer returns 400.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.9 (LTS) adds Vertex labels and fixes Foundry /openai/v1
points: `vertex_request_label_fields` labels Vertex calls with the caller's key, team, org and project.
Foundry project `/openai/v1` bases no longer return 400, and resource-level `/openai/v1` Responses bases no longer return 404.
`s3://` image, PDF and video URLs on Bedrock Converse models go to Bedrock as S3 sources instead of returning 500.

title: LiteLLM v1.106.10 fixes repeated sign-in on Google MCP servers
points: Google MCP servers no longer ask users to sign in again when the access token expires.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.8 (LTS) fixes Azure Decisions calls and an MCP sign-in loop
points: `azure/` deployments no longer return 400 on `/v1/decisions`.
MCP sign-in no longer loops to `Authentication incomplete` on servers that answer `mcp_all` with detailed scopes.

title: LiteLLM v1.108.7 (LTS) adds Gemini batches and Bedrock image search
points: `/v1/batches` runs Gemini batches with output download through `/v1/files`, and Bedrock knowledge bases accept image search with `query_image`.
Azure AI Foundry deployments support gpt-image edits, and Gemini image calls bill text, thinking and Vertex Priority tokens at the correct rates.
Responses-only fields such as `max_tool_calls` return 400 on providers bridged through chat completions unless you set `drop_params: true`.
